items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, Gussie's dead and his brother. He plays cornet and, uh...

ctx.x: Martin Coych. Yeah, Martin. He's dead and his brother, Robbie, is dead too. And now, Gussie Zinneman ain't dead, is he?
No, Gussie's dead and his brother. He plays cornet and, uh...

Clarinet. And clarinet. That's, uh, that's Zinneman. That's Coych, Martin Coych. He was good too. That's the, that was in Alexander, Louisiana there. Yeah, that's an old, I got another picture of that. Sitting on the piano or something? That other picture, that other move.
